SSL::release
Description
Releases the collected plaintext data to the next layer/filter up.
Syntax
SSL
::
release
[
<
length
>
]
SSL::release [<length>]
Releases the collected plaintext data to the next layer/filter up.
Examples
when
SERVERSSL_HANDSHAKE
{
# Trigger collection of the decrypted payload once the SSL handshake has been completed successfully
SSL
::
collect
}
when
SERVERSSL_DATA
{
# Do something with the decrypted data
set
payload
[
SSL
::
payload
]
# Release the payload
SSL
::
release
}
